description: Reads what the current webinar session has collected so far — topic, audience, date, texts state. Read-only: no session is created, no site is touched, nothing is written. The session already holds what it was told, so nothing in it has to be asked again. Needs `session_id`.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

name: wi_get_session_facts
title: Read the collected webinar facts
